Dear [Miss Durton](../persons.html#458)
Your Good Friday has been a long time on its way, owing to the misdirection, but I have it now, and I wish I could have got it into the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52) for Easter, though even if it had come direct it would not have been in time for April.
I am very glad to hear more of Ottavia’s family and will insert this when I can.[^1] Perhaps another time you had better write direct to me.

My paper is so thick that I will only put in this one half sheet

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Both \'Ottavia\' MP 3s 14 (July 1887), 87-96, and \'A Good Friday Procession at Grassina\' MP 3s 19 (April 1890) 371-6, appeared under the name \'E.Vere\'.

They purport to be real life accounts of Italian peasantry, and the author perhaps lived in Italy.
